# Ghoul: Bethesda Developer AMA (All Questions and Answers)

![Ghoul: Bethesda Developer AMA (All Questions and Answers)](/uploads/475_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

[Update March 17, 2025] Correction from Bethesda: The 6th character slot will not be available in tomorrow's update.

![](/uploads/nukaknights-post-ghoul-update-discord.jpg)

Yesterday on March 14th, 2025 a live stream with a question round took place in the official Bethesda Discord. There were some interesting answers here to topics that we could only speculate about so far.

Reddit user "fmk89" documented these questions and answers. Thank you for this work! Bethesda's questions and answers can be read here indented as a quote. In between you will find comments from me.

**Will ghouls be overpowered at launch?**
No, they will be different from humans and will each have their own strengths and weaknesses.

See also [PTS] Ghoul Perks: All new perk cards

**Will there be a way to speed up ferocity?**

Not at launch, but planned for the future.

That's actually a shame, because as a wild melee ghoul you should completely forego chems. Otherwise the melee bonus is lost immediately.

**Can masks or other clothing act as camouflage?**

No. The only effective disguises are donned and removed by the NPC Jay. However, you can still wear Power Armor while in disguise.

It's a shame, for me personally this is a reason not to play the ghoul on my main character. I like the look of the ghoul and don't want to always have to visit an NPC and walk around with a sack on my head, e.g. Want to buy gold plans or enclave plans.

**What character customization options are available for ghouls?**

They are just as robust as human characters, and there are plans to further expand customization options after release.

**Can ghouls cause radiation damage?**

Yes, perks that consume glow add radiant effects and damage to attacks.

**Do Assassin's Legendary effects work against Ghoul players in PvP?**

No, you need Ghoul Slayer's for the same effect.

This could be a new challenge for PvP players if they don't recognize whether someone is playing a ghoul or a human and then have the "wrong" gear ready.

**Will my character's facial changes remain if I transform into a ghoul?**

No, you have to create your ghoul persona from scratch. If you transform them back, you will regain your previous human appearance.

That's good news, I haven't been able to test this myself yet as I'm still testing things as a ghoul. Some players have spent hours or maybe even days on character design, if that were reset it would be very bad.

**Do wild ghouls react differently to ghoul players?**

In general they remain aggressive, but for story purposes some unique interactions may be introduced in the future.

I was also surprised to find this on the PTS. Even if there is a wild ghoul, you will be attacked by wild ghoul NPCs. You could see that in some PTS videos, e.g. the video with the new locations. To be honest, I find this a bit illogical.

**Are daily challenges adjusted to allow ghouls to complete them?**

Yes, that was taken into account.

I'm excited about that. I suspect you will still have to “roll” as a ghoul for some challenges.

**Will allies in the camp comment on your transformation? Will there be any ghoul-related companions in the future?**

Probably.

**Can ghouls receive food and drink buffs?**

Yes.
